map.为什么距离加倍降 6 dB？: Why does doubling the distance drop 6 dB?
map.声强与距离平方成反比，能量扩散到 4 倍面积，10·log10(1/4)≈−6: Sound intensity is inversely proportional to the square of distance; the energy spreads over 4 times the area, and 10*log10(1/4) is about -6 dB.
map.反平方定律何时不成立？: When does the inverse square law fail?
